messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — NovaSys (SI) asked for our pen-test window for the upcoming marketplace listing. They also want to confirm what artifacts we'll hand over (SOC2, network config, app diagram) and how we handle redaction.

josh: @maria thanks — what's the initial scope? external network only or full app + infra? Need to know whether SOC2 covers it or if we need extra attestations.

anika: From marketplace side: we require SOC2 Type II or equivalent, a recent vuln-scan + third-party pen test report, and a short questionnaire. Vendor portal expects files uploaded by vendor. Dates matter for listing cadence.

maria: Proposed timeline: artifacts uploaded Oct 9, pen-test window Oct 12–16, report ingest by Oct 20. Does that work for security/eng?

liam: Ok. For artifact sharing I suggest: create artifact-bundle (zip) with manifest, run automated redaction script, then upload to secure S3 with per-file presigned URLs (TTL 72h). We can add an allowlist for SI tester IPs. Command for manifest:
```
python tools/pack_artifacts.py --source ./artifacts --out bundle_{{date}}.zip --manifest manifest.json
sha256sum bundle_{{date}}.zip > bundle_{{date}}.sha256
```

josh: checklist reminders: scope doc, emergency contact, test accounts, token rotation plan, secrets not included. Also confirm whether partner wants full request logs — prefer structured logs with PII removed.

anika: Who owns redaction? I'd like Partner Ops to own vendor coordination, Security to approve redaction rules. @liam can you provide the redaction script and rough runtime?

liam: script is in repo, it strips emails/SSNs, replaces IPs with token placeholders. Runtime ~5–10m for current bundle. I'll send README and run a test drop this Friday.

maria: I'll create a short runbook page and a single-source checklist. Link: https://redwood.internal/marketplace/pen-runbook (draft). Action items: - create bundle (maria) - run redaction (liam) - generate presigns (eng-infra) - share to SI + PM (anika) - security review (josh)

josh: Also confirm whether we need to rotate keys after tests. Recommend rotate any long-lived keys used in test accounts within 24h post-test.

anika: I'll loop in NovaSys PM and schedule a quick kickoff call next week. Can someone post the final artifact list by EOD Thu?

maria: Will do. tagging final owners: @liam, @josh, @anika. :thumbsup:

sec-bot: Reminder scheduled — 48 hours before artifact drop and 72 hours before pen window.
